units.statusDetail: Complete pending owner credentials. E01 service layer (src/engine/, committed to main before this registry update: organizations, memberships, versioned roles/purposes, compartments, sessions, tokens, grants, revocation, OIDC, intake federation, TOTP, refresh rotation) plus PR #22 (governance views, redacted projections, rate limits, invitations, password reset port, required MFA, row policies, deployment acceptance). Provider protocol/cryptography (OIDC code+PKCE, JWKS id-token verification) and intake federation are implemented and tested against local providers; account linking (actor mappings, invitations accepted by an existing account), provisioning by invitation and recovery (TOTP recovery codes, password reset through a host delivery port and signed webhook) are implemented. Live OIDC sign-in and real reset delivery need the owner's provider client and mailer (docs/OWNER_STEPS.md §2–3).
units.priorStatus: Partial: merged PR2 supplies pinned managed intake service verification with explicit local non-owner identity mapping. PR3 snapshots trusted mappings and bounds credential/transport/body verification with cancellation, finite byte/chunk budgets, strict JSON UTF8 and sanitized failures. Merged PR20 adds a provider-neutral human federation boundary: exact enabled issuer/subject/audience mappings yield only bounded local actor IDs, claims cannot supply roles or scope, absolute freshness/expiry and cancellation fail closed, and current roles remain owned by membership-session resolution. Provider protocol/cryptography, automatic member provisioning/account linking/recovery and live host integration remain pending.
